entries.source:
Avoid taking damage by
making use of Evade<sprite name="Evade">, Block<sprite name="Block">
and Suppression<sprite name="Suppression">.
entries.translation:
利用闪避<sprite name="Evade">、
格挡<sprite name="Block">
和压制<sprite name="Suppression">来避免受到伤害。
entries.note: TooltipDefinition.GetTooltipText 四种参数的原生输出：Avoid Taking Damage Tag Box Definition

entries.source:
Emotions are Status Effects
that can be Buffs or Debuffs.
Any Status Effect with an <color=#808080>[</color><color=#A61FFF>Emotion</color><color=#808080>]</color>
Tag is considered an Emotion.
Inspect Status Effects by holding <g>[<color=#FCC926>{key:inspect}</color>]</g>.
entries.translation:
情绪是一类状态效果，
可以是增益或减益。
任何带有<color=#808080>[</color><color=#A61FFF>情绪</color><color=#808080>]</color>
标签的状态效果都属于情绪。
按住<g>[<color=#FCC926>{key:inspect}</color>]</g>查看状态效果。
entries.note: TooltipDefinition.GetTooltipText 四种参数的原生输出：Bard - Emotion Tooltip

entries.source:

entries.source:
Magic Find<Magic_Find>
Chance for:
<SubArrow>Upgrading Item Rarity
<SubArrow>Completing <color=#00B824>Sets</color>
<SubArrow>Weapons to be Pre-Enchanted
Makes you find more Rare,
Epic and Legendary items.
entries.translation:
魔法寻宝<Magic_Find>
影响以下事件的几率：
<SubArrow>提升物品稀有度
<SubArrow>集齐<color=#00B824>套装</color>
<SubArrow>武器自带附魔
使你更容易找到稀有、
史诗和传说物品。
entries.note: TooltipDefinition.GetTooltipText 四种参数的原生输出：Magic Find Tag Box Definition

entries.source:

Damage Over Time Effects.

包括光环
和持续伤害效果。

entries.source: (*)Recover [[{number:n0}]] Hearts on Revive. (*)Revive refreshes every Floor.
entries.translation: (*)复活时恢复[[{number:n0}]]颗心。 (*)复活会在每层刷新。
entries.note: TooltipDefinition.GetTooltipText 四种参数的原生输出：Revive Tag Box Definition

entries.source:
Debuffs are Status Effects
that weaken Enemies.
Any Status Effect with a <color=#808080>[</color><color=#A61FFF>Debuff</color><color=#808080>]</color>
Tag is considered a Debuff.
Inspect Status Effects by holding <g>[<color=#FCC926>{key:inspect}</color>]</g>.
entries.translation:
减益是一类
削弱敌人的状态效果。
任何带有<color=#808080>[</color><color=#A61FFF>减益</color><color=#808080>]</color>
标签的状态效果都属于减益。
按住<g>[<color=#FCC926>{key:inspect}</color>]</g>查看状态效果。
entries.note: TooltipDefinition.GetTooltipText 四种参数的原生输出：Soldier - Debuff Tooltip

entries.source:
Ailments are Status Effects
applied by certain Damage Types.
For example, Chill from Cold Damage.
If the Ailment deals Damage, such as
Burn, increasing the Effect will also
increase the Damage.
Any Status Effect with an <color=#808080>[</color><color=#A61FFF>Ailment</color><color=#808080>]</color>
Tag is considered an Ailment.
Inspect Status Effects by holding <g>[<color=#FCC926>{key:inspect}</color>]</g>.
entries.translation:
异常是一类由
特定伤害类型施加的状态效果。
例如冰冷伤害造成的寒冷。
如果异常会造成伤害，例如
燃烧，提高其效果也会
提高伤害。
任何带有<color=#808080>[</color><color=#A61FFF>异常</color><color=#808080>]</color>
标签的状态效果都属于异常。
按住<g>[<color=#FCC926>{key:inspect}</color>]</g>查看状态效果。
entries.note: TooltipDefinition.GetTooltipText 四种参数的原生输出：Sorcerer - Ailment Tooltip
